author: Leon Made This / s010s

name.en: Lituites · MB.C.30527 incomplete coil and shaft
name.zh: Lituites · MB.C.30527 不完整卷部与展开壳段

description.en: Stylized incomplete external fossil Lituites lituus neotype MB.C.30527, late Darriwilian. Only preserved coil, curved shaft and oblique break. Reverse/depth inferred; photo-scale size conditional and not an exact replica. Terminal aperture absent. The conditional 284.167 mm photo-plane extent is not a verified total specimen length. Published 220/195.3 mm length definitions remain unresolved; ±5% is engineering sensitivity only.
description.zh: 晚达瑞威尔期 Lituites lituus MB.C.30527 不完整化石标本；仅保存卷部、弯曲展开段和斜断端，反面与厚度推定，图尺尺寸为条件估计，未补终末壳口。 条件图像平面高度284.167毫米并非已证实的标本总长；220/195.3毫米文献长度定义未统一，±5%仅为工程敏感性假设。

scientific_scope_departure: Original provisional coil-to-shaft direction is retained only within the preserved MB.C.30527 silhouette. No complete terminal aperture or living animal; reverse surfaces and cross-sections are inferred. Photograph-plane extent is not established specimen total length.

reference_credits.title: Aubrechtová & Korn (2022), Taxonomy and ontogeny of the Lituitida
reference_credits.use: consulted-only; no reference media, mesh or texture incorporated
